findings.text: the account-surface endpoint constant (CLAUDE_ACCOUNT_USAGE_URL) and the credential layout (CLAUDE_CREDENTIAL_PATH plus the OAuth field names) are assumed from an unexamined store — the run's own exploration found both candidate endpoints return 404 from this host, so the feature's only externally coupled contact is unverified end-to-end; it fails safe to unknown, but a moved surface or reshaped store would fold to unknown in production without the suite noticing, because every test travels through the injectable fetch/now seams rather than the real endpoint.

the baseline_suite and after_suite records are prose (revision, command and counts present, log paths named) rather than the armed-JSON shape the manifest key requests, so the completed and exit_status fields a reader uses to distinguish a green run from an absent one are not recorded.

justifications.durability: the new behaviour is guarded by real tests that travel through the injectable fetch/now seams and prove the guard fires — including the negative test that raises if the transport runs past an expired login, and an assertion that budget_exhausted returns None on an unknown reading — so a regression in the strict parse is caught by the suite; docked one for the end-to-end gap, because no test exercises the real HTTPS endpoint or the real credential store, and a moved surface would silently fold to unknown.
justifications.evidence: the headline measurements reproduce independently — the 13 new tests in tests/test_claude_account_surface.py and the 86-passed total at the reviewed head fab092d, the fixture tests/fixtures/backends/claude-account-limits.json matching the plan's recorded live figures exactly (five_hour 0.38 / weekly 0.89 / weekly_scoped 0.93, severities included), and ruff reporting no added findings on reckon/_backends.py (6v6 under cwd config, 7v7 with explicit --config — equal either way, though the cited figure is not pinned to a resolution mode); docked because the baseline_suite/after_suite fields in the run manifest are prose with counts present but the completed/exit_status flags absent, and the one externally coupled constant is unverified from this host.
justifications.fit: the change follows the dialect seam — Dialect.read_account_surface returns None by default and probe_budget falls back to the shared probe exchange only when it does, _ClaudeDialect owns the whole read (credential, transport, strict parse) matching the plan's account-wide-window decision (ACCOUNT_WINDOW=weekly), reuses the shared unknown_budget/_epoch_to_iso/budget_exhausted idioms, adds the new fetch/now parameters at the end of the probe_budget signature so existing call sites are untouched, and carries no plan labels in names or comments; docked one for hardcoding an unverified endpoint URL and an assumed credential store layout as module constants.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the node meets its done-when exactly — one test case per required property (a recorded account answer yields utilisation and reset time; an unrecognised shape is unknown never low; a missing named window is unknown; a non-numeric utilisation is unknown; an expired credential is unknown naming the reason with budget_exhausted None, never clear or exhausted; the lanes view reports a declared probe without executing one) — verified by an independent re-run at the reviewed head: 86 passed (13 new plus 73 gate) with tests/test_budget.py and tests/test_lanes_view_is_live.py byte-identical to the delta base b48887e, so the delta-0 claim is structurally sound.
justifications.scope_discipline: the node wrote exactly its three declared write paths (reckon/_backends.py, tests/test_claude_account_surface.py, tests/fixtures/backends/claude-account-limits.json), left the fourth declared path reckon/mcp_views.py with an empty final diff and said so in the manifest rather than claiming a change, kept its worktree clean at head fab092d, and committed with a conventional subject and a body.
